parameters: "Village Elder's house.  No visitors without appointment, please."
"Wait - I know that voice - Alice?  Is that you?"
"Alice!  We've been looking all over two big islands for you!  Are you okay?"
"Yeah, I'll be okay now, now that I've found you.  I was sucked into whatever artificial magical reality that you and your friends have
going in our basement game room.  Was it your old friend Benny?  After it took you and your friends away Sekk managed to dodge it and
head upstairs, but it then got me and I ended up in this magical reality game world.  It feels like one of Benny's games where he's the
DM or Game Master, running things."
"Yeah, it's that twerp Benny.  Well I'm glad you're okay.  Anyways, if we stick together and solve the puzzles of this world, maybe we can
all go back home to real life together.  We need to find a way to stop a supervolcano from exploding, or somehow save all the life of this
world - people, plants, trees, animals, everything - from when it goes kaboom.  We were told by some Wise Guy that we needed to get to this
island as our next step.  I don't know what that is, but I'm glad I found you and you're okay."
"That old guy who everyone says knows stuff?  Yeah, I saw him too, and he said that whoever would come and fix this
world's problems would need to defeat a half-machine cyber-dragon to get a magic wand that moves rocks - big ones -
from it's lair.  Somehow that would lead to getting to the end of all of this.  He also told me about another shrine
where he has a twin brother, known as The Other Wise Guy Who Makes Stuff."
"Sounds like that twin has an invention that will fix the supervolcano or something, and we need the rock-moving wand to get to him,
or for him to make something out of it.
Where did you say this cyber dragon is?"
"It lives in a sandy cave on a tropical island with sand dunes and palm trees, to the northwest of here.  Really powerful
monsters guard the outside of it, even worse ones inside it, and we need a boat to get there.  We can find supplies for the
trip in this town if we need to.  The Wise Guy Who Knows Stuff also gave me a pass-code for getting into the dragon's cave."
"This cyber dragon, what type of dragon is it's non-machine half, by the way?  Just curious."
"Traditional European folklore reptilian, from the middle ages.  Not zarakite.  Not like what half of you is."
